facts.fact: HeyGen's Creator plan costs $29 per month, with videos up to 5 minutes long and unlimited video count, according to the Rask.ai article.

facts.fact: HeyGen's Team plan costs $89 per month, allowing unlimited videos with a 60-minute duration, according to the Rask.ai article.

facts.fact: HeyGen's free plan allows up to 3 videos per month, each lasting up to 3 minutes, with all exported videos carrying a watermark, according to the Rask.ai article.

facts.fact: HeyGen's free plan includes up to 60 studio avatars and one custom avatar, according to the Rask.ai article.

facts.fact: The Creator plan allows up to 3 instant avatars created from the user's photos, according to the Rask.ai article.
